review.gong.faq.a1: Gong uses custom enterprise pricing typically ranging $1,200-2,000/user/year. Small teams (10-25 users) can expect ~$30K-50K/year, while enterprise deployments (200+ users) often exceed $250K/year. Contact Gong sales for specific quotes based on your team size, features, and contract terms.
review.gong.faq.q2: What's the difference between Gong and Chorus.ai?
review.gong.faq.a2: Both are excellent conversation intelligence platforms. Gong is generally considered more comprehensive with deeper AI analysis, broader feature set, and stronger revenue intelligence capabilities. Chorus.ai (now ZoomInfo) integrates tightly with ZoomInfo's ecosystem and may offer better value for existing ZoomInfo customers. Gong typically commands higher pricing but delivers more advanced insights.
review.gong.faq.a3: Yes, Gong offers robust native Salesforce integration that bidirectionally syncs conversation data, automatically creates tasks, updates opportunities, and enriches CRM records with AI insights. The integration is considered best-in-class and enables sophisticated workflows between conversation intelligence and CRM data.
review.gong.faq.a4: For mid-market and enterprise B2B sales organizations with complex deals and meaningful contract values, Gong typically delivers strong ROI through improved win rates (20-35%), better forecast accuracy (10-20%), and faster rep productivity (30-50% ramp time reduction). Payback periods of 6-12 months are common. Smaller teams or transactional sales may struggle to justify the premium pricing.
review.gong.faq.q5: Can Gong record all my sales calls?
review.gong.faq.a5: Yes, Gong automatically records and transcribes calls across phone systems, video conferencing platforms (Zoom, Teams, Meet), and email. It supports 70+ languages with 95%+ accuracy. The platform respects consent requirements and provides compliance controls for regulated industries. All recordings are searchable and analyzable through Gong's AI engine.
